definition_zh: 课程；全部课程体系；（一门课或一个专业的）教学计划；履历（拉丁短语引申）
definition_en: the subjects taught by a school, college or university, or the particular course of study that a student follows
core_image: 一条被划成若干段的跑道，跑者必须一段接一段跑完，每段都标着一门课
scene: 开学前，教务处的长桌上摊着一份排到毕业的课表，每一格都对应一门课。The curriculum for the four-year programme was rewritten to include statistics and fieldwork.
sceneCN: 这里 curriculum 指「一个学校或一个专业为学生安排的全部课程及其顺序」（第 1 个义项：作为整体路线的课程安排）；句意为这套四年制培养方案的课程被重新编写，加入了统计学与野外实习。可辨识物件：长桌、摊开的课表、铅笔、文件夹。

pos.zh: 课程；全部课程体系；（一门课或一个专业的）教学计划

senses.title: The route one class must run
senses.definition: the subjects and sequence that one class or programme covers from beginning to end
senses.definitionCN: 一门课或一个培养方案从开头到结尾要覆盖的科目与顺序
senses.example: The history curriculum begins with local records and ends with recent elections.
senses.exampleCN: 历史课程从地方档案开始，到最近的选举结束。
senses.why: The Latin word meant a racecourse, so the first sense is the route itself rather than the subjects on it.
senses.whyCN: 这个词在拉丁语里指跑道，所以第一义是路线本身，而不是路线上的科目。

senses.title: A programme's plan of study
senses.titleCN: 一个专业或年级的培养方案
senses.definition: the whole set of courses arranged for a degree or for one stage of schooling
senses.definitionCN: 为一个学位或一个学段安排的全部课程
senses.example: The engineering curriculum requires two terms of mathematics.
senses.exampleCN: 工程专业的培养方案要求修满两个学期的数学。
senses.why: Once a route is fixed, the stages along it turn into a plan that can be written and approved.
senses.whyCN: 路线一旦定下，沿途的各段就变成可以书写和审批的计划。

senses.title: Everything a school offers
senses.definition: all the courses an institution makes available to its students
senses.definitionCN: 一所学校向学生提供的全部课程
senses.example: The catalogue lists the full curriculum of the college.
senses.exampleCN: 课程目录列出了这所学院开设的全部课程。
senses.why: The same word widens from one runner's route to every route the institution has laid out.
senses.whyCN: 同一个词从一名跑者的路线，扩展到这所学校铺下的所有路线。

senses.title: A written course document
senses.definition: a document stating the aims, content, sequence and assessment of a course
senses.definitionCN: 说明一门课的目标、内容、顺序与考核方式的文件
senses.example: Teachers revised the curriculum before the inspectors arrived.
senses.exampleCN: 在督学到来之前，教师们修订了课程文件。
senses.why: A route that has to be shared with colleagues needs to be put on paper.
senses.whyCN: 要与同事共享的路线，必须落到纸上。

senses.title: The unwritten lessons
senses.definition: the values, habits and expectations a school passes on without listing them
senses.definitionCN: 学校不明文列出却照样传递的价值、习惯与期待
senses.example: Punctuality is part of the hidden curriculum of the school.
senses.exampleCN: 守时是这所学校隐性课程的一部分。
senses.why: Some of what a school teaches never appears on the paper plan, yet it is still taught.
senses.whyCN: 学校教的东西有一部分从不出现在纸面计划上，却照样被教出去。

senses.title: The course of a life
senses.definition: a record of a person's education and employment, from the Latin phrase for the course of a life
senses.definitionCN: 个人教育与任职经历的记录，来自表示「人生跑道」的拉丁短语
senses.example: She attached a curriculum vitae to every application.
senses.exampleCN: 她每份申请都附上一份履历。
senses.why: The Latin phrase for the course of a life keeps the running image for a whole career.
senses.whyCN: 那个表示「人生跑道」的拉丁短语，把跑动的意象保留给了整个职业生涯。

senses.title: The old racecourse
senses.definition: the original Latin sense of a race or of the track it was run on
senses.definitionCN: 拉丁语原义：一场赛跑，或赛跑所用的跑道
senses.example: Commentators still gloss the Latin word as a racecourse.
senses.exampleCN: 注释者仍把这个拉丁词解释为跑道。
senses.why: The educational word is a late borrowing of an everyday word for a footrace.
senses.whyCN: 这个教育术语是对一个表示赛跑的日常词的晚期借用。

senses.title: The study of curricula
senses.definition: the academic field that examines how courses are designed, sequenced and evaluated
senses.definitionCN: 研究课程如何设计、排序与评估的学科
senses.example: Curriculum as a field of study expanded quickly after the war.
senses.exampleCN: 课程论作为一门学科在战后迅速扩张。
senses.why: When people study tracks themselves, the word becomes the name of a discipline.
senses.whyCN: 当人们开始研究「跑道」本身，这个词就成了学科的名字。

intro.en: Curriculum comes from Latin curriculum 'a running, a racecourse', built on currere 'to run'. The educational sense is medieval, and the dates below are approximate.
intro.cn: curriculum 来自拉丁语中表示「跑动、跑道」的名词，由表示「跑」的动词构成。教育义产生于中世纪，下列年代均为约数。

items.en: Currere 'to run' supplies the root; its Indo-European ancestor is reconstructed as a form meaning 'to run', so that root is a reconstruction, not a recorded word.
items.cn: 表示「跑」的拉丁动词提供词根；其印欧祖形被重构为一个表示「跑」的形式，这一词根属重构形式，并非有记录的词。

items.en: Curriculum named a running, a race, and the track the race was run on; it later also meant a career, the course of a public life.
items.cn: 这个拉丁名词指跑动、赛跑，也指赛跑用的跑道；后来还指仕途，即公共生活的历程。

items.en: Medieval schools used the word for a fixed sequence of studies, keeping the image of a track that must be completed in order.
items.cn: 中世纪学校用这个词指固定的学习顺序，保留了「必须按次序跑完的跑道」这一意象。

items.en: English adopted curriculum in the seventeenth century for a course of study; the date of the earliest educational use is not firmly fixed.
items.cn: 英语在十七世纪借入这个词，指一门学习课程；最早的教育用法年代并无确证。

items.en: From the nineteenth century the word has named the whole prescribed set of subjects for a school or degree, which is its dominant sense today.
items.cn: 从十九世纪起，这个词指一所学校或一个学位所规定的全部科目，这一义项今天占主导。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin and first date): the pre-Latin root is only a reconstructed form, and the earliest school citation cannot be dated with confidence.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源与首见年代）：拉丁语之前的词根只是重构形式，最早的学校书证也无法确定年代。

note.en: Group one holds words that sit beside curriculum in a school timetable or share its running root; group two holds the near neighbours that name a smaller or differently framed unit of study.
note.cn: 第一组是在课表上与课程并列、或与「跑」同根而易混的词；第二组是所指单位更小或框架不同的近义词。

entries.definition: From Latin cursus 'a running', the same root as curriculum; it names one unit of teaching, while curriculum names the whole track.
entries.definitionCN: 来自拉丁语中表示「跑动」的名词，与 curriculum 同根；它指一门课程，而 curriculum 指整条路线。

entries.definition: From Old French carriere 'racecourse, street', from Latin carrus 'cart'; its track is a road for vehicles, not a running root.
entries.definitionCN: 来自古法语中表示「跑道、街道」的词，源头是拉丁语「车」；它的「跑道」是车走的路，并非「跑」这个词根。

entries.definition: From Latin currere through the participle currens 'running'; it describes water, air or electricity in motion, not a course of study.
entries.definitionCN: 经拉丁语分词「跑动的」来自「跑」这个动词；它描述水、空气或电流的运动，而非学习课程。

entries.definition: From a Greek word for a parchment label; it lists the contents of one course and is not a relative of curriculum.
entries.definitionCN: 来自希腊语中表示羊皮纸标签的词；它列出一门课的内容，与 curriculum 并无同源关系。

entries.definition: The full plan of study for a degree, often used where curriculum would sound old-fashioned or too institutional.
entries.definitionCN: 一个学位的完整学习计划，常用于课程一词显得陈旧或过于机构化的场合。

entries.definition: One taught unit with its own timetable and assessment; a curriculum is made of many courses.
entries.definitionCN: 一个有独立课表与考核的教学单元；课程体系由许多这样的单元组成。

entries.definition: A self-contained block of teaching inside a programme, usually shorter than a course.
entries.definitionCN: 培养方案中自成一块的教学单位，通常比一门课更短。

entries.definition: A branch of knowledge as taught in school, such as history or chemistry; a curriculum arranges such subjects into a sequence.
entries.definitionCN: 学校教授的某一知识分支，如历史或化学；课程体系把这样的科目排成顺序。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real Latin root, the real school phrases and the real relatives of the word.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的拉丁词根、真实的学校说法与这个词的真实同族词。

normal.en: The Latin root means 'to run', so a curriculum is the track a student must run to the end.
normal.cn: 拉丁词根意为「跑」，所以课程就是学生必须跑到终点的那条跑道。

normal.en: The same running root also built course and current, which both carry the idea of movement.
normal.cn: 同一个表示「跑」的词根还造出了表示「课程」与「流动」的词，它们都带着运动的意味。

normal.en: School phrases mark the whole-programme sense: national curriculum, core curriculum, curriculum reform.
normal.cn: 学校里的固定说法标出整体义：国家课程、核心课程、课程改革。

normal.en: The plural has two accepted spellings, a Latin one and an English one; academic writing prefers the Latin.
normal.cn: 复数有两种被接受的写法，一种按拉丁语，一种按英语；学术写作多用前者。

normal.en: A curriculum vitae is literally the course of a life, the same word applied to a person rather than a school.
normal.cn: 履历的完整说法字面就是「人生的跑道」，同一个词用在了人身上而不是学校身上。

abstract.en: Picture a train that can only reach the last station if it stops at every station in between.
abstract.cn: 想象一列火车，只有逐站停靠才能抵达终点站。

abstract.en: Picture a recipe whose steps cannot be swapped without ruining the dish.
abstract.cn: 想象一份食谱，步骤一旦调换，菜就做坏了。

abstract.en: Picture a map on which the roads are drawn before anyone has walked them.
abstract.cn: 想象一张地图，路在还没有人走过时就已经画好了。

examples.en: The department added a data ethics unit to the curriculum.
examples.cn: 该系在课程体系中加入了一个数据伦理单元。

examples.en: Parents complained that the hidden curriculum rewarded silence over curiosity.
examples.cn: 家长抱怨隐性课程奖励沉默而压制好奇。

examples.en: Her curriculum vitae listed four years of laboratory work.
examples.cn: 她的履历列出了四年的实验室工作。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「跑完一程」——学生沿着排好的路线一程程跑完，就是课程体系

root: 拉丁语表示「跑」的动词 → 名词「跑动、跑道、赛程」；英语 curriculum 指按顺序排好的课程体系。词根的上古祖形属重构形式，不作定论。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one image: a marked track. It narrows to one class, widens to a whole school, turns into paper, then into lessons nobody writes down, then into a life, and finally into the study of tracks themselves.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿着同一个意象展开：一条划好分段的跑道。它先收窄到一门课，再扩展到整所学校，然后落到纸上，变成无人写下的课，接着用于一个人的一生，最后成为研究跑道本身的学科。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a marked track that a runner must complete section by section.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条划好分段的跑道，跑者必须一段一段跑完。

branches.en: THE TRACK AND ONE ROUTE: the Latin racecourse narrows into the route a single class follows.
branches.cn: 跑道与单条路线：拉丁语的赛跑场收窄为一门课要走的那条路。

branches.en: THE INSTITUTION'S WHOLE MAP: every subject a school lays out, taken as one drawing.
branches.cn: 学校的整张地图：学校铺开的全部科目，被当成一幅图来看。

branches.en: PAPER AND PRACTICE: first the written plan, then the values taught without being written.
branches.cn: 纸面与实践：先是有字的计划，再是没有写下却照样教的价值。

branches.en: THE COURSE OF A LIFE: the running image moves from a school to a single person.
branches.cn: 人生的跑道：跑动的意象从学校移到一个人身上。

branches.en: RACE AND DISCIPLINE: the old footrace survives in the dictionary while the study of courses becomes a field of its own.
branches.cn: 赛跑与学科：旧的赛跑义留在词典里，而课程研究自成一门学问。

intro.en: Curriculum is a Latin noun whose root, suffix and plural are all visible in English words, so the family can be read morpheme by morpheme.
intro.cn: curriculum 是一个拉丁名词，其词根、后缀与复数形式在英语词中都看得见，因此整个词族可以按语素逐个读出。

latinIntro.en: The Latin verb for running gives curriculum, cursus and currere; the noun suffix marks a result or an instrument, and the plural keeps the Latin ending.
latinIntro.cn: 表示「跑」的拉丁动词衍生出表示「课程」「行程」与「跑」的几个词；名词后缀表示结果或工具，复数则保留拉丁词尾。

items.example: The verb supplies the root of the whole family.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词提供整个词族的词根。

items.meaning: a running; a racecourse; a course of study
items.example: The noun first named a track, then a course.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词先指跑道，后指课程。

items.example: Several curricula were compared in the study.
items.exampleCN: 该研究比较了几套课程体系。

items.meaning: relating to a course of study
items.example: Curricular hours were cut that year.
items.exampleCN: 那一年课内学时被削减。

items.structure: Latin phrase, 'the course of a life'
items.meaning: a personal record of education and posts
items.meaningCN: 个人教育和工作经历记录
items.example: The Latin phrase became the formal name for a resume.
items.exampleCN: 这个拉丁短语成了简历的正式名称。

items.example: It shares the running root with curriculum.
items.exampleCN: 它与 curriculum 共享「跑」这个词根。

definition_zh: 课程的；属于学校课程范围的；与课程内容、设计或考核相关的
definition_en: relating to a curriculum, or belonging to the official course of study of a school or programme
core_image: 一块被画进课表方框里的区域，框内的活动算课，框外的活动不算
scene: 校历上把每周三下午留白，那段时间不排任何课内任务。The committee drew a clear line between curricular activities and after-school clubs.
sceneCN: 这里 curricular 指「属于学校正式课程范围的」（第 1 个义项：与课程整体相关）；句意为委员会在课内活动与课后社团之间划出明确界线。可辨识物件：校历、彩色方框、课程表、社团海报。

pos.zh: 课程的；属于正式课程范围的；与课程设计或考核相关的

senses.title: Relating to a curriculum
senses.definition: connected with the course of study as a whole rather than with a single lesson
senses.definitionCN: 与作为整体的课程有关，而不是与单独一节课有关
senses.example: The school published a curricular review every three years.
senses.exampleCN: 这所学校每三年发布一次课程审查报告。
senses.why: The adjective simply attaches the noun's whole-track meaning to whatever it describes.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词只是把名词「整条路线」的意思附加到它所修饰的对象上。

senses.title: Inside the official course
senses.definition: counted as part of formal instruction rather than as an optional extra
senses.definitionCN: 算作正式教学的一部分，而非可选的附加活动
senses.example: Field trips are curricular only when a teacher records them.
senses.exampleCN: 只有教师登记在案时，校外考察才属于课内活动。
senses.why: A border has to be drawn somewhere, and the adjective marks what falls inside it.
senses.whyCN: 边界总要划在某处，这个形容词标记的正是落在界内的事物。

senses.title: Required for progression
senses.definition: prescribed as necessary before a student may move to the next stage
senses.definitionCN: 规定为学生进入下一学段之前必须完成的
senses.example: Two laboratory courses are curricular for the major.
senses.exampleCN: 两门实验课是该专业的必修内容。
senses.why: A track only works as a track if some sections cannot be skipped.
senses.whyCN: 跑道之所以是跑道，就在于有些段不能跳过。

senses.title: Designed for classroom use
senses.definition: prepared to be taught in lessons, as opposed to self-study material
senses.definitionCN: 为在课堂上讲授而准备，而非自学材料
senses.example: The publisher labelled the new units curricular materials.
senses.exampleCN: 出版方把这套新单元标为课程教材。
senses.why: The word marks the place where a plan is meant to be delivered, namely the classroom.
senses.whyCN: 这个词标记的是计划准备被交付的场所，也就是课堂。

senses.title: Concerning subject content
senses.titleCN: 与学科教学内容有关的
senses.definition: about what a subject contains and how its content is ordered
senses.definitionCN: 关于某个学科包含什么以及内容如何编排
senses.example: Curricular content in biology now includes statistics.
senses.exampleCN: 生物学的课程内容如今包含统计学。
senses.why: Content becomes curricular once it is selected and ordered for teaching.
senses.whyCN: 内容一旦为教学而被挑选并排序，就成了课程内容。

senses.title: Used in curriculum planning
senses.titleCN: 用于课程规划与改革的
senses.definition: appearing in discussions of how courses are designed, revised or approved
senses.definitionCN: 出现在关于课程如何设计、修订或批准的讨论中
senses.example: The reform was mostly a curricular question, not a budget question.
senses.exampleCN: 这次改革主要是课程问题，不是预算问题。
senses.why: Planning talks about the track before anyone runs it, and the adjective names that stage.
senses.whyCN: 规划在还没人开跑时就讨论跑道，这个形容词命名的正是那个阶段。

senses.title: Counted toward credit
senses.definition: recognised as part of a student's academic credit, as in a supervised internship
senses.definitionCN: 被认定为学生学分的一部分，如带督导的实习
senses.example: Her curricular internship counted as one full course.
senses.exampleCN: 她的课程实习算作一门完整课程。
senses.why: Work outside the classroom can be pulled inside the track if it is given credit.
senses.whyCN: 课堂之外的工作只要给学分，就能被拉进这条跑道。

senses.title: Judged by course criteria
senses.definition: assessed through the requirements and standards of a course
senses.definitionCN: 通过某门课的要求与标准来评估
senses.example: The oral exam was curricular, so it followed the syllabus.
senses.exampleCN: 口试属于课程考核，因此按课程纲要出题。
senses.why: Assessment closes the loop: what is taught inside the track is also judged inside it.
senses.whyCN: 考核把回路闭合：在跑道内教的东西，也在跑道内评判。

intro.en: Curricular is an English adjective built on curriculum plus a suffix meaning 'relating to'. Both parts come from Latin, and the dates are approximate.
intro.cn: curricular 是英语形容词，由表示「课程体系」的名词加一个表示「与……相关」的后缀构成。两部分都源自拉丁语，年代均为约数。

items.en: The noun named a running, a racecourse and later a course of study, and it supplies the whole stem of the adjective.
items.cn: 这个名词指跑动、跑道，后来指课程，它为形容词提供整个词干。

items.en: The Latin suffix -aris formed adjectives meaning 'belonging to' or 'concerned with', as in militaris from miles.
items.cn: 拉丁后缀构成表示「属于」或「涉及」的形容词，如由「士兵」构成的「军事的」。

items.en: English keeps the same suffix in adjectives such as familiar and similar, and curricular follows that pattern.
items.cn: 英语在若干形容词中保留了同一后缀，curricular 沿用的正是这一模式。

items.en: The adjective spread with compulsory schooling, when schools needed a word for what counted as official instruction.
items.cn: 这个形容词随义务教育普及而扩散，因为学校需要一个词来指什么算正式教学。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date): the exact moment when the adjective entered school documents is not recorded, and the pre-Latin root of the stem remains a reconstruction.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代）：这个形容词进入学校文件的准确时点没有记录，词干在拉丁语之前的来源仍是重构形式。

note.en: Group one holds adjectives and nouns built on the same school stem; group two holds words that describe teaching arrangements from a different angle.
note.cn: 第一组是同出校园词干的形容词与名词；第二组是从别的角度描述教学安排的近义词。

entries.definition: The noun names the track; the adjective says that something belongs to it, so the two are never interchangeable.
entries.definitionCN: 名词指那条跑道；形容词表示某物属于它，两者不能互换。

entries.definition: The prefix means 'outside', so it names exactly what curricular excludes, such as clubs and teams.
entries.definitionCN: 前缀意为「在外」，它命名的正是课程范围所排除的部分，如社团与球队。

entries.definition: The prefix means 'together', so the activity runs alongside coursework and is often credited.
entries.definitionCN: 前缀意为「共同」，这类活动与课程并行，常被计入学分。

entries.definition: A compound meaning 'founded on a curriculum'; it adds a particle rather than a suffix and stays hyphenated.
entries.definitionCN: 复合词，意为「以课程为依据」；它加的是小品词而非后缀，通常带连字符。

entries.definition: Concerned with education or scholarship in general, not specifically with the content and sequence of courses.
entries.definitionCN: 泛指与教育或学术有关，并不专指课程的内容与顺序。

entries.definition: About the act and materials of teaching rather than the plan being taught.
entries.definitionCN: 关于教学行为与教学材料，而非所教的计划本身。

entries.definition: Built on the outline of a single course, a narrower unit than a whole curriculum.
entries.definitionCN: 以单门课的纲要为依据，单位比整套课程更窄。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the noun it comes from, the suffix that makes it an adjective, and the pairs schools actually use.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：它所来自的名词、把它变成形容词的后缀，以及学校实际使用的成对说法。

normal.en: Add a relating-to suffix to the noun for a course of study and you get the adjective.
normal.cn: 在表示「课程体系」的名词后加一个表示「相关」的后缀，就得到这个形容词。

normal.en: The useful contrast is inside versus outside: curricular activities count, extracurricular ones do not.
normal.cn: 最有用的对比是界内与界外：课内活动算数，课外活动不算。

normal.en: A co-curricular activity is tied to lessons, which is why the prefix means 'together'.
normal.cn: 配套课程的活动与课业绑在一起，所以前缀是「共同」的意思。

normal.en: If a course requirement appears on the degree sheet, it is curricular by definition.
normal.cn: 一项要求若出现在学位表上，按定义就是课程必修内容。

normal.en: The adverb form is rare, so the adjective usually appears before a noun such as activities, hours or reform.
normal.cn: 副词形式罕用，因此这个形容词通常放在活动、学时或改革这类名词之前。

abstract.en: Picture a fence around a playground: the grass inside is curricular, the grass outside is not.
abstract.cn: 想象操场周围有一道栅栏：栏内的草地算课内，栏外的草地不算。

abstract.en: Picture a stamp pressed on some pages of a book and no others.
abstract.cn: 想象一枚印章只盖在书里某些页上，别处不盖。

abstract.en: Picture a ticket that is valid only on one named route.
abstract.cn: 想象一张只在指定路线上有效的车票。

examples.en: The survey asked how many curricular hours students actually received.
examples.cn: 这项调查询问学生实际上了多少课内学时。

examples.en: Curricular reform stalled because no department would give up its hours.
examples.cn: 课程改革停滞，因为没有院系愿意让出学时。

examples.en: The museum visit became curricular once it was tied to an assignment.
examples.cn: 博物馆参观一旦与作业挂钩，就成了课内活动。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「课内」——凡是写在课表方框里的，都是课程的

root: curriculum（课程体系，源自拉丁语「跑道」）+ 表示「与……相关」的拉丁形容词后缀；英语 curricular 即「属于课程范围的」。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all draw one border: what falls inside the official track of study. The border tightens from the whole curriculum to a required course, then to materials, planning, credit and assessment.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都在划同一条边界：什么落在正式学习的跑道之内。这条边界从整套课程收紧到必修课，再延伸到教材、规划、学分与考核。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a box drawn around certain school activities; whatever is inside the box counts.
core.cn: 核心意象：在学校活动外围画一个方框，框内的一切才算数。

branches.en: THE WHOLE TRACK: the adjective first says that something belongs to the course of study as a whole.
branches.cn: 整条跑道：这个形容词首先表示某物属于作为整体的课程。

branches.en: INSIDE AND REQUIRED: the border marks official instruction, and some of it cannot be skipped.
branches.cn: 界内与必修：边界标出正式教学，其中有些段不能跳过。

branches.en: MATERIAL AND CONTENT: what is taught in class, and what a subject is made to contain.
branches.cn: 教材与内容：课堂上教的东西，以及一个学科被安排去包含的东西。

branches.en: THE PLANNING TABLE: reform and design happen before anyone enters the classroom.
branches.cn: 规划桌上：改革与设计发生在任何人走进教室之前。

branches.en: CREDIT AND JUDGEMENT: the track also decides what earns credit and how it is tested.
branches.cn: 学分与评判：这条跑道还决定什么能挣到学分、又如何被考核。

intro.en: Curricular is transparent: a Latin noun stem plus a Latin adjective suffix, both of which recur across English.
intro.cn: curricular 的构造一目了然：一个拉丁名词词干加一个拉丁形容词后缀，两部分在英语中反复出现。

latinIntro.en: The stem means 'course of study'; the suffix means 'relating to'. English also uses the same suffix in words such as similar and regular.
latinIntro.cn: 词干意为「课程」；后缀意为「与……相关」。英语在表示「相似」「规则」的词中也用同一后缀。

items.example: The stem carries the whole-track meaning.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干承载「整条路线」的意思。

items.example: The suffix turns a noun into a describing word.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把名词变成描述性的词。

items.meaning: relating to a course of study

items.exampleCN: 这门工作室课程与课业并行。

items.example: The choir meets in extracurricular time.
items.exampleCN: 合唱团在课外时间活动。

items.example: The adjective and noun are learned together.
items.exampleCN: 这个形容词与名词通常一起学。

items.meaning: from the point of view of coursework
items.example: The adverb is rare in modern writing.
items.exampleCN: 这个副词在现代写作中罕用。

items.meaning: not part of the course of study
items.example: Noncurricular reading was left to the holidays.
items.exampleCN: 非课程阅读被留到假期。

latinEntries.meaning: a running; a racecourse; a course

definition_zh: 教学大纲；课程纲要；（考试的）考查范围；摘要，目录（旧义）
definition_en: a plan of the subjects and topics in a course, or the list of subjects prescribed for an examination
core_image: 一张贴在教室门口的纸，上面按周次列出主题、阅读与考试日期
scene: 开学第一周，老师把一张印着周次、主题与书单的纸发到每人手里。Our syllabus lists the readings for each week and the date of the final essay.
sceneCN: 这里 syllabus 指「一门课的教学大纲，列出主题、进度与阅读材料」（第 1 个义项：单门课的课程纲要）；句意为我们的课程纲要列出每周阅读材料与期末论文的日期。可辨识物件：打印纸、周次栏、书单、红笔圈出的日期。

pos.zh: 教学大纲；课程纲要；（考试的）考查范围；摘要，目录（旧义）

derivatives.zh: 大纲设计（应用语言学用语）

senses.title: The outline of one course
senses.definition: a document that sets out the topics, sequence and requirements of a single course
senses.definitionCN: 说明单门课的主题、顺序与要求的文件
senses.example: The syllabus opens with the question the course is built around.
senses.exampleCN: 这份课程纲要一开头就提出整门课围绕的问题。
senses.why: The word names the paper a teacher hands out so that everyone follows the same plan.
senses.whyCN: 这个词指教师发下的那张纸，好让所有人遵循同一份计划。

senses.title: The attached reading list
senses.titleCN: 随大纲附上的阅读书目
senses.definition: the list of texts and pages students are expected to read for the course
senses.definitionCN: 学生按课程要求要读的文本与页码清单
senses.example: The syllabus runs to nine pages of required reading.
senses.exampleCN: 这份纲要附了九页必读书目。
senses.why: Reading is the part of the plan that students can carry out alone, so it is listed separately.
senses.whyCN: 阅读是计划中学生能独自完成的部分，因此被单独列出。

senses.title: The prescribed scope of an exam
senses.definition: the body of material a test or awarding body says may be examined
senses.definitionCN: 考试机构规定可能被考查的材料范围
senses.example: Nothing outside the syllabus will appear on the paper.
senses.exampleCN: 试卷不会出现大纲以外的内容。
senses.why: Once a test exists, the plan must state its limits so that candidates know what to prepare.
senses.whyCN: 一旦有了考试，计划就必须写明界限，让考生知道准备到哪里。

senses.title: The outline for a qualification
senses.definition: the full programme of study set by a board or ministry for a qualification
senses.definitionCN: 由考试委员会或教育主管部门为一个资格设定的完整学习纲要
senses.example: The national syllabus for nursing was revised last year.
senses.exampleCN: 全国护理课程纲要去年做了修订。
senses.why: The same word scales up from one classroom to a whole qualification system.
senses.whyCN: 同一个词可以从一间教室扩展到一个完整的资格证书体系。

senses.title: A summary or abstract
senses.definition: a short statement of the main points of a longer work, an older sense still found in titles
senses.definitionCN: 对较长作品要点的简短陈述，这一旧义仍见于书名
senses.example: The volume opens with a syllabus of the argument.
senses.exampleCN: 这卷书以一份论证提要开篇。
senses.why: Long before schools used the word, it named a condensed list of contents.
senses.whyCN: 在学校使用这个词之前很久，它就指压缩过的内容清单。

senses.title: A table of contents
senses.definition: a list of the divisions of a book or document, the sense from which the modern word developed
senses.definitionCN: 书籍或文件各部分的清单，现代词义由此发展而来
senses.example: The medieval manuscript carries a syllabus at the front.
senses.exampleCN: 这份中世纪手稿的开头有一份目录。
senses.why: A table of contents is literally a list of headings, which is what the source word meant.
senses.whyCN: 目录字面上就是一份标题清单，这正是源词的意思。

senses.title: The summary of a judgment
senses.definition: in law, a short statement of the points decided in a case, printed before the opinion
senses.definitionCN: 法律用语：印在判决意见之前的判决要点摘要
senses.example: The reporter's syllabus is not part of the court's opinion.
senses.exampleCN: 判例汇编的要旨并不属于法院意见本身。
senses.why: Lawyers borrowed the older summary sense for the headnote of a reported case.
senses.whyCN: 法律人借用了较古的「摘要」义，用来指判例汇编的题头摘要。

senses.title: The list fixed by an exam board
senses.titleCN: 考试委员会规定的科目清单
senses.definition: the subjects and set texts a board requires for a school certificate
senses.definitionCN: 考试机构为学校证书规定的科目与指定文本
senses.example: The board publishes a new syllabus every five years.
senses.exampleCN: 考试委员会每五年发布一份新的科目纲要。
senses.why: A board must tell every school the same list, so the word becomes an official schedule.
senses.whyCN: 考试委员会必须向所有学校通告同一份清单，这个词于是成了官方章程。

intro.en: Syllabus reached English through Modern Latin, where it meant 'list, table of contents'. Its best-known explanation is a copying error, and the dates are approximate.
intro.cn: syllabus 经现代拉丁语进入英语，那里意为「清单、目录」。最流行的解释是抄录错误，年代均为约数。

items.en: The likely source is a Greek word for a parchment label or title slip; beyond Greek, its origin is not established and is marked as source uncertain.
items.cn: 较可信的来源是希腊语中表示羊皮纸标签或题签的词；在希腊语之前，其来源未得证明，标为来源不确定。

items.en: Editions of Cicero printed a Latin-looking form where the Greek accusative plural stood; the mistake is generally thought to have produced the Latin word.
items.cn: 西塞罗作品的版本在希腊语宾格复数处印出了一个像拉丁语的写法；一般认为这个拉丁词正是由此产生的错误。

items.en: The invented form took on the meaning 'list, table of contents' and was used for headings and summaries.
items.cn: 这个被造出的形式取得了「清单、目录」的意思，用于标题与摘要。

items.en: English adopted it in the seventeenth century for a summary or abstract, especially of a printed work.
items.cn: 英语在十七世纪借入该词，指摘要或提要，尤指印刷作品的提要。

items.en: By the nineteenth century it had shifted to the outline of a course and the scope fixed for an examination.
items.cn: 到十九世纪，它转向指一门课的纲要与考试规定的范围。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date): the earliest English citation is not securely dated, and the chain back to Greek rests on an inference from a copying error.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代）：最早的英语书证年代不确，追溯到希腊语的链条依赖对一处抄录错误的推断。

note.en: Group one holds words that look or sound like syllabus but come from unrelated sources; group two holds the documents and plans it is regularly confused with.
note.cn: 第一组是形或音与 syllabus 相近但来源无关的词；第二组是常被它混淆的文件与计划。

entries.definition: From Greek syn- 'together' plus lambanein 'to take', a unit of sound; it shares the opening letters only by accident.
entries.definitionCN: 来自希腊语「共同」加「拿取」，是语音单位；开头的字母相同只是巧合。

entries.definition: From Greek syn- plus logizesthai 'to reason', a form of argument; the resemblance to syllabus is only in the first syllable.
entries.definitionCN: 来自希腊语「共同」加「推理」，是一种论证形式；与 syllabus 的相似只在首音节。

entries.definition: From Greek symbolon 'a token', literally something thrown together for comparison; not related to the parchment label.
entries.definitionCN: 来自希腊语「信物」，字面是扔在一起对证之物；与那个羊皮纸标签无关。

entries.definition: A set of written signs for syllables; it belongs to the syllable family, not to the syllabus family.
entries.definitionCN: 一套表示音节的书写符号；它属于「音节」词族，不属于「大纲」词族。

entries.definition: The full course of study across a programme; a syllabus is the outline of one course inside it.
entries.definitionCN: 一个培养方案的完整课程；大纲只是其中一门课的纲要。

entries.definition: A neutral phrase for the same document, used where syllabus sounds formal or regional.
entries.definitionCN: 指同一份文件的中性说法，在大纲一词显得正式或地域化时使用。

entries.definition: A teacher's longer-term plan of what will be taught week by week, often more detailed than a syllabus.
entries.definitionCN: 教师按周安排教学内容的较长计划，常比课程纲要更细。

entries.definition: Only the books and articles for a course; it is one section of a syllabus, not the whole.
entries.definitionCN: 只列一门课的书目与文章；它是纲要的一部分，而非全部。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the document itself, the exam scope it fixes, and the real words it is contrasted with.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：这份文件本身、它所固定的考查范围，以及真正与它对照的词。

normal.en: A syllabus answers three questions: what will be taught, in what order, and how it will be tested.
normal.cn: 一份课程纲要回答三个问题：教什么、按什么顺序、怎么考。

normal.en: The word began as a table of contents, which is exactly what a course outline still looks like.
normal.cn: 这个词原本指目录，而课程纲要至今仍长得像一份目录。

normal.en: School phrases keep it tied to one course: course syllabus, examination syllabus, syllabus design.
normal.cn: 校园里的固定说法把它绑在单门课上：课程纲要、考试大纲、大纲设计。

normal.en: If a topic is on the syllabus, a teacher is expected to cover it and a test may ask about it.
normal.cn: 一个主题若列入纲要，教师就该讲到，考试也可能考到。

normal.en: Syllable and syllogism look alike but belong to entirely different Greek families.
normal.cn: 「音节」与「三段论」形似，却分属完全不同的希腊词族。

abstract.en: Picture a menu that lists dishes but does not cook them.
abstract.cn: 想象一份菜单，列出菜名却不做菜。

abstract.en: Picture a route card handed out before a journey, with each stop numbered.
abstract.cn: 想象出发前发的一张行程卡，每一站都编了号。

abstract.en: Picture a fence marking the ground a race will be run on, and the ground it will not.
abstract.cn: 想象一道栅栏，标出赛跑要跑的地面和不会跑的地面。

examples.en: The syllabus warns that late work loses ten percent a day.
examples.cn: 课程纲要警告说，迟交的作业每天扣百分之十。

examples.en: Candidates should check the examination syllabus before choosing a text.
examples.cn: 考生选文本前应先查考试大纲。

examples.en: The legal syllabus is a summary, not the court's own reasoning.
examples.cn: 判例要旨只是摘要，并非法院自身的论证。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「撕了不撕」——一张写着课程安排的纸，撕了也得照着做 → 教学大纲

root: 现代拉丁语「清单、目录」，一般认为由抄录西塞罗文本时对希腊语「羊皮纸标签」一词的误读而来；英语 syllabus 指课程纲要或考试范围，更深来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow a list that becomes a plan: a table of contents, a summary, an exam scope, and finally the outline of a single course.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿着「清单变成计划」这条线展开：先是目录，再是摘要、考查范围，最后落为一门课的纲要。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a sheet of paper that lists what will be covered, week by week.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张纸，按周列出将被覆盖的内容。

branches.en: THE OLDEST LIST: a table of contents is still a list of headings and nothing more.
branches.cn: 最古老的清单：目录依旧只是一份标题清单。

branches.en: CONDENSED POINTS: a summary of an argument and a summary of a judgment both shorten a longer text.
branches.cn: 压缩要点：论证提要与判例要旨都在缩短一篇更长的文字。

branches.en: THE EXAM LINE: a scope is a list that also says where the questions stop.
branches.cn: 考试界线：范围是一份清单，同时说明题目到哪里为止。

branches.en: THE CLASSROOM SHEET: topics and readings arrive on one page for one group of students.
branches.cn: 教室里的那张纸：主题与阅读材料为同一批学生出现在一页上。

branches.en: THE OFFICIAL SCHEDULE: a board lifts the same list to a whole qualification and fixes it for every school.
branches.cn: 官方章程：考试机构把同一份清单抬到一个完整资格，并对所有学校固定下来。

intro.en: Syllabus has no productive English affixes of its own; the useful units are the Latin-shaped ending and the modern compounds built on it.
intro.cn: syllabus 本身没有能产的英语词缀；有用的单位是它的拉丁式词尾，以及在它之上构成的新复合词。

latinIntro.en: The word is a Modern Latin coinage standing for a Greek term; its plural keeps the Latin-looking ending, and English also allows a regular plural.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词是现代拉丁语造出的形式，对应一个希腊术语；复数保留拉丁式词尾，英语也允许规则复数。

items.meaning: a list or table of contents
items.example: The word entered English as a list of headings.
items.exampleCN: 这个词最初以标题清单的身份进入英语。
档案室保存着旧课程纲要。
这场考试以大纲为依据。

items.meaning: the work of arranging a course outline
items.example: Syllabus design is taught in applied linguistics.
items.exampleCN: 应用语言学教授大纲设计。

items.meaning: the scope fixed for a test
items.example: The examination syllabus is issued by the board.
items.exampleCN: 考试大纲由考试委员会发布。

items.example: The title uses the older summary sense.
items.exampleCN: 这个书名用的是较古的摘要义。

items.meaning: the first week when outlines are handed out
items.example: Nothing serious happens in syllabus week.
items.exampleCN: 发纲要的那一周通常不安排正经内容。

latinEntries.structure: syllabus (Modern Latin noun, 'list, table of contents')
latinEntries.meaning: a list; a table of contents

definition_zh: 教学，讲授；指示，命令；（复数）操作说明；（计算机）指令；法官对陪审团的指示
definition_en: the act of teaching, or a statement telling someone what to do, or a single step a computer performs
core_image: 一位师傅把材料递到学徒手里，一边搭起框架，一边告诉他每一步该放在哪里
scene: 泳池边，教练先示范手臂动作，再让学员照着做。Her instruction in the butterfly stroke began with slow arm movements at the pool edge.
sceneCN: 这里 instruction 指「对某项技能的教学与指导」（第 1 个义项：教学、讲授）；句意为她的蝶泳教学从池边缓慢的手臂动作开始。可辨识物件：泳池边沿、浮板、秒表、教练手势。

pos.zh: 教学，讲授；指示，命令；（复数）操作说明；（计算机）指令

senses.title: Teaching in a classroom
senses.definition: the act of teaching someone a subject or a skill, usually over time
senses.definitionCN: 在较长时间里教授某人一门科目或一项技能
senses.example: Her instruction in the butterfly stroke began with slow arm movements.
senses.exampleCN: 她的蝶泳教学从缓慢的手臂动作开始。
senses.why: The Latin noun meant both 'arrangement' and 'teaching': to teach is to set knowledge in order inside a learner.
senses.whyCN: 这个拉丁名词既指「安排」也指「教学」：教书就是把知识在学员头脑中排好次序。

senses.title: A direction or order
senses.definition: a statement telling someone what they must do
senses.definitionCN: 告诉某人必须做什么的话
senses.example: He left strict instructions that nobody was to enter the room.
senses.exampleCN: 他留下严格指示，任何人不得进入那个房间。
senses.why: An order is also an arrangement imposed on someone else's actions, so the same word covers both.
senses.whyCN: 命令也是强加在他人行动上的一种安排，于是同一个词兼指两者。

senses.title: The steps for using something
senses.definition: a set of written steps explaining how to use or assemble something
senses.definitionCN: 说明如何使用或组装某物的成文步骤
senses.example: Read the instructions before switching on the pump.
senses.exampleCN: 开泵之前先读操作说明。
senses.why: When the arrangement is written down for a user, the plural is the normal form.
senses.whyCN: 当这套安排为用户写成文字时，通常用复数形式。

senses.title: One computer operation
senses.definition: a single operation that a processor can carry out, such as adding two numbers
senses.definitionCN: 处理器能执行的一个操作，如把两个数相加
senses.example: The loop repeats one instruction millions of times.
senses.exampleCN: 这个循环把一条指令重复数百万次。
senses.why: Computing borrowed the word because a program is literally a list of orders given to a machine.
senses.whyCN: 计算机领域借用这个词，因为程序字面上就是一串下给机器的命令。

senses.title: A judge's charge to the jury
senses.definition: the explanation of the law a judge gives jurors before they decide a case
senses.definitionCN: 法官在陪审团裁决前对法律适用所作的说明
senses.example: The defence objected to one sentence in the instruction.
senses.exampleCN: 辩方对指示中的一句话提出异议。
senses.why: A court must tell the jury how to apply the law, and that telling is formally an instruction.
senses.whyCN: 法院必须告知陪审团如何适用法律，而这种告知在形式上就是一项指示。

senses.title: A formal directive to an official
senses.titleCN: 对官员或代表的正式训令
senses.definition: an official order setting out what an envoy or officer may and may not do
senses.definitionCN: 规定使节或官员可为与不可为的正式命令
senses.example: The ambassador acted beyond her instructions.
senses.exampleCN: 这位大使的行为超出了她的训令。
senses.why: Diplomacy needs a written boundary, and the word names the document that sets it.
senses.whyCN: 外交需要一条书面边界，这个词就指划定边界的那份文件。

senses.title: Training in a practical skill
senses.definition: organized practice that builds a physical or technical skill
senses.definitionCN: 为培养体能或技术技能而组织的练习
senses.example: Swimming instruction is compulsory in the third year.
senses.exampleCN: 游泳训练在三年级是必修的。
senses.why: Skill is built by repeated directions plus correction, which is instruction in its most physical form.
senses.whyCN: 技能靠反复的指令加纠正来建立，这是这个词最具体力的一面。

senses.title: The old sense of arranging
senses.definition: the older meaning of setting something out or furnishing it with what it needs
senses.definitionCN: 较古的意义：把某物布置好，或给它配备所需之物
senses.example: The Latin noun also meant the fitting out of a house or an army.
senses.exampleCN: 这个拉丁名词也曾指对房屋或军队的装备配置。
senses.why: The modern teaching sense grew out of this: a mind is furnished with knowledge the way a house is furnished with goods.
senses.whyCN: 现代的教学义由此生长出来：头脑被知识装备，正如房屋被器物装备。

intro.en: Instruction comes from Latin instructio 'an arranging, an equipping, a teaching', built on instruere 'to build in, set in order'. The dates are approximate.
intro.cn: instruction 来自拉丁语中表示「安排、装备、教导」的名词，由表示「搭入、排好」的动词构成。年代均为约数。

items.en: Struere meant 'to pile up, build, arrange'; its Indo-European source is reconstructed as a form meaning 'to spread out', so that root is a reconstruction.
items.cn: 这个拉丁动词意为「堆起、建造、排列」；其印欧来源被重构为一个表示「铺开」的形式，属重构形式。

items.en: The prefix 'into' plus struere produced instruere 'to build in, furnish, equip, and hence prepare and teach'.
items.cn: 表示「进入」的前缀加「建造」，构成表示「搭入、配备、装备，进而准备与教导」的动词。

items.en: The action noun instructio covered arrangement, equipment and the act of teaching, and all three passed into later languages.
items.cn: 动作名词兼指安排、装备与教学行为，这三层意思都传入了后来的语言。

items.en: English took instruction for teaching and for a direction, and the plural became the standard form for written steps.
items.cn: 英语借入这个词表示教学与指示，复数则成为书面步骤的通常形式。

items.en: In the twentieth century the word gained a technical sense in computing, one machine step, and an established legal sense, a judge's charge.
items.cn: 到二十世纪，这个词在计算机领域获得「一条机器步骤」的技术义，在法律领域获得「法官指示」的固定义。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin): the pre-Latin root is a reconstructed form, and no single source explains how 'equipping' became 'teaching'.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源）：拉丁语之前的词根是重构形式，「装备」如何转为「教导」也没有单一来源可解释。

note.en: Group one holds words built on the same Latin verb for building, which are easily confused with instruction; group two holds words for telling or teaching.
note.cn: 第一组是同出那个表示「建造」的拉丁动词、易与 instruction 混淆的词；第二组是表示告知或教学的近义词。

entries.definition: Built on the same verb, but it names a tool or device, something equipped for a task rather than words that teach.
entries.definitionCN: 同出那个动词，但它指工具或器械，是为任务配备之物，而不是教人的话。

entries.definition: From the same building root; it names the arrangement itself, not the act of telling someone what to do.
entries.definitionCN: 同出「建造」词根；它指安排本身，而非告知他人如何行动的行为。

entries.definition: To build something by putting parts together; the root is shared, but there is no element of teaching.
entries.definitionCN: 把部件组合起来建造某物；词根相同，但完全没有教学的含义。

entries.definition: From a Latin verb meaning 'to look at', not from the building root; it names immediate understanding without instruction.
entries.definitionCN: 来自表示「注视」的拉丁动词，而非「建造」词根；它指不经教导的直接领会。

entries.definition: The ongoing activity or profession of helping someone learn; instruction often stresses method and directness.
entries.definitionCN: 帮助他人学习的持续活动或职业；instruction 更强调方法与直接性。

entries.definition: Guidance on how to do something, often less binding than an instruction.
entries.definitionCN: 关于如何做某事的指引，约束力通常比 instruction 弱。

entries.definition: A command from someone with power; instruction can also mean this, but it is the harsher word.
entries.definitionCN: 有权力者下的命令；instruction 也可表此义，但「命令」语气更硬。

entries.definition: The book that holds the instructions; it is the container, not the content.
entries.definitionCN: 承载操作说明的书册；它是容器，不是内容本身。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the building root, the classroom sense and the paper that carries the steps.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：「建造」词根、课堂义，以及承载步骤的那张纸。

normal.en: The Latin verb means 'to build in', so instruction is knowledge built into someone.
normal.cn: 那个拉丁动词意为「搭进去」，所以教学就是把知识搭进一个人心里。

normal.en: The same root appears in structure, construct and instrument, all through the idea of building.
normal.cn: 同一词根出现在表示「结构」「建造」与「工具」的词中，都经由「建造」这一概念。

normal.en: School and workplace phrases split the senses: religious instruction, operating instructions, instruction manual.
normal.cn: 学校与工场的固定说法把义项分开：宗教教导、操作说明、使用手册。

normal.en: In computing an instruction is one step, the smallest order a processor can obey.
normal.cn: 在计算机里，一条指令就是一步，是处理器能服从的最小命令。

normal.en: A judge's instruction is not advice; the jury is required to apply the law as explained.
normal.cn: 法官的指示不是建议；陪审团必须按所解释的法律适用。

abstract.en: Picture a hand guiding another hand along a tool.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手扶着另一只手沿着工具移动。

abstract.en: Picture a folded note tucked into a machine, read one line at a time.
abstract.cn: 想象一张折好的纸条塞在机器里，每次只读一行。

abstract.en: Picture scaffolding around a half-built wall, taken down once the wall stands.
abstract.cn: 想象半成的墙外搭着脚手架，墙立稳后便被拆掉。

examples.en: The instruction was clear enough for a beginner to follow.
examples.cn: 这条说明清楚到初学者也能照做。

examples.en: Poor instruction in mathematics leaves gaps that never close.
examples.cn: 数学教学不到位会留下永远补不上的缺口。

examples.en: The program executes one instruction at a time.
examples.cn: 这个程序一次执行一条指令。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「引着搭」——把人引进门、搭起框架 → 教学与指示

root: 拉丁语表示「建造、排列」的动词，加表示「进入」的前缀，构成「搭入、装备、教导」；英语 instruction 指教学、指示与操作说明。其印欧词根属重构形式。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one gesture: something is built into a person or a system. Teaching builds knowledge, an order builds a boundary, a manual builds steps, and a machine executes one built-in step at a time.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一个动作展开：把某物搭进一个人或一个系统。教学搭进知识，命令搭出边界，手册搭出步骤，机器则一次执行一条内置步骤。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: pieces fitted into a frame, one after another, until the structure can stand.
core.cn: 核心意象：一块块部件依次嵌进框架，直到结构能立起来。

branches.en: TEACHING AND DRILL: lessons and repeated practice both build competence into a learner.
branches.cn: 教学与操练：课程与反复练习都把能力搭进学习者身上。

branches.en: THE BINDING WORD: a plain order and a formal directive both compel someone to act.
branches.cn: 有约束力的话：普通命令与正式训令都迫使某人行动。

branches.en: PAPER STEPS: a manual arranges the order for a user who has never done the task.
branches.cn: 纸面步骤：手册为从未做过此事的使用者排好次序。

branches.en: ONE MACHINE STEP: computing shrinks the order to the smallest operation a processor obeys.
branches.cn: 一条机器步骤：计算机把命令缩小为处理器能服从的最小操作。

branches.en: CHARGE AND EQUIPPING: the judge and the old sense of fitting out both give someone what is needed to act.
branches.cn: 指示与装备：法官的说明与旧的配备义，都是给某人行动所需之物。

intro.en: Instruction is a Latin noun with three separable pieces, and those pieces also build a large English family.
intro.cn: instruction 是一个可拆成三部分的拉丁名词，这些部分还构成了一大批英语词。

latinIntro.en: The prefix means 'into', the verb means 'build', and the action suffix turns the verb into a noun; English keeps all three in related words.
latinIntro.cn: 前缀意为「进入」，动词意为「建造」，动作后缀把动词变成名词；英语在相关词中保留了这三部分。

items.example: The verb is the root of the whole family.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词是整个词族的根。

items.example: The prefix turns building into building in.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀把「建造」变成「搭进去」。

items.meaning: to build in; to equip; to prepare
items.example: An army was equipped and a mind was prepared by the same verb.
items.exampleCN: 同一动词既能装备一支军队，也能准备一个人的头脑。

items.meaning: an arranging; an equipping; a teaching
items.example: The noun carries all three senses at once.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词同时承载三层意思。

items.example: The word arrived with both senses intact.
items.exampleCN: 这个词带着两个义项一起进入英语。

latinEntries.meaning: to build in; to equip; to teach

definition_zh: 教师；（大学）讲师；教练，指导员；指导手册（旧义）
definition_en: a person who teaches a subject or trains people in a skill, especially in a practical or college setting
core_image: 副驾驶座上坐着一个人，脚边也有一副刹车，随时准备替学员踩下
scene: 驾校的副驾驶座上，一名教员脚边也有一副刹车，随时准备替学员踩下。The instructor beside her kept a second brake within reach during the first lesson.
sceneCN: 这里 instructor 指「教授某项技能并在旁边纠正的教练或教员」（第 1 个义项：大学或训练机构中的教师）；句意为第一堂课上，坐在她旁边的教练脚边备着第二副刹车。可辨识物件：副驾驶座、副刹、方向盘、后视镜。

pos.zh: 教师；（大学）讲师；教练，指导员；指导手册（旧义）

senses.title: A college teacher
senses.definition: a teacher at a college or university, often below the rank of professor
senses.definitionCN: 学院或大学里的教师，职级通常低于教授
senses.example: The instructor taught two sections of introductory economics.
senses.exampleCN: 这位讲师教两个班的经济学入门。
senses.why: The agent noun simply names the person who performs the act of instructing.
senses.whyCN: 这个施事名词只是命名执行「教导」这一动作的人。

senses.title: A driving instructor
senses.definition: a person who teaches someone to drive and supervises practice on the road
senses.definitionCN: 教人驾驶并在路上监督练习的人
senses.example: The instructor beside her kept a second brake within reach.
senses.exampleCN: 坐在她旁边的教练脚边备着第二副刹车。
senses.why: A skill learned in a moving vehicle needs someone able to take control instantly.
senses.whyCN: 在行驶的车里学技能，必须有人在旁能立刻接管。

senses.title: A fitness instructor
senses.definition: a person who leads exercise sessions and corrects posture and technique
senses.definitionCN: 带领训练课并纠正姿势与技术的人
senses.example: The instructor adjusted the bar before the next set.
senses.exampleCN: 教练在下一组之前调整了杠铃。
senses.why: Bodies learn by correction, so the word follows the person who supplies it.
senses.whyCN: 身体靠纠正来学习，这个词因此跟着提供纠正的人走。

senses.title: A flight instructor
senses.definition: a licensed pilot who trains student pilots in the air and on the ground
senses.definitionCN: 在空中与地面训练学员飞行员的持照飞行员
senses.example: Her flight instructor signed off the solo before winter.
senses.exampleCN: 她的飞行教员在入冬前批准了单飞。
senses.why: The highest-stakes training keeps the same title, because the act of instructing does not change with altitude.
senses.whyCN: 风险最高的训练仍用同一称谓，因为教导这一行为不因高度而改变。

senses.title: A sports or outdoor instructor
senses.titleCN: 运动或户外项目的教练
senses.definition: a person who teaches skiing, swimming, climbing or a similar physical skill
senses.definitionCN: 教授滑雪、游泳、攀岩等身体技能的人
senses.example: The ski instructor took the beginners down the easiest slope.
senses.exampleCN: 滑雪教练带初学者走最容易的那条坡。
senses.why: Each sport keeps the general word rather than inventing a new title, since teaching method is shared.
senses.whyCN: 各项运动都沿用这个通称而不另造头衔，因为教学方法相通。

senses.title: A military instructor
senses.definition: a soldier whose duty is to drill recruits in weapons, tactics or discipline
senses.definitionCN: 负责训练新兵武器、战术或纪律的军人
senses.example: The drill instructor counted cadence on the parade ground.
senses.exampleCN: 操练教官在阅兵场上喊着步伐节拍。
senses.why: Armies were among the first institutions to make instruction a specialized role.
senses.whyCN: 军队是最早把「教导」变成专职角色的机构之一。

senses.title: A book that instructs
senses.definition: an older use of the word for a manual or guide that teaches its reader
senses.definitionCN: 较古的用法，指教导读者的手册或指南
senses.example: The eighteenth-century instructor sold better than the novel.
senses.exampleCN: 那本十八世纪的指南书比小说卖得好。
senses.why: Before teaching was a profession, the word could name the printed thing that did the teaching.
senses.whyCN: 在教学成为职业之前，这个词可以指承担教导的那本印刷物。

senses.title: The Latin sense of a preparer
senses.definition: the original sense of one who arranges or equips something for others
senses.definitionCN: 原义：为他人安排或配备某物的人
senses.example: In Latin the word described the person who fitted out a house or a campaign.
senses.exampleCN: 在拉丁语里，这个词指为房屋或战事做配备的人。
senses.why: The modern teacher and the old organizer share the idea of getting someone ready.
senses.whyCN: 现代教师与旧的筹备者共享「让某人准备好」这一要点。

intro.en: Instructor is the agent noun of the Latin verb instruere 'to equip, arrange, teach'; the personal ending -or marks the one who acts. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: instructor 是拉丁动词「装备、安排、教导」的施事名词，表示人的词尾标记行动者。年代均为约数。

items.en: Instruere combined 'into' with 'build' to mean 'build in, equip, prepare', and it already covered both equipment and teaching.
items.cn: 这个拉丁动词把「进入」与「建造」合起来，表示「搭入、装备、准备」，本就兼指装备与教导。

items.en: The suffix -or marked the person who carries out the action, as in doctor or victor, so instructor was the one who equipped or prepared.
items.cn: 后缀标记执行动作的人，如「医生」或「胜利者」，因此这个词指做配备或准备的人。

items.en: English adopted instructor for a teacher, first in religious and then in general education.
items.cn: 英语借入这个词指教师，先用于宗教教导，再扩展到一般教育。

items.en: In the twentieth century the title spread to driving, flying, skiing and fitness, where instruction is sold as a service.
items.cn: 到二十世纪，这一称谓扩展到驾驶、飞行、滑雪与健身，这些领域的教学成为一项服务。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date): the earliest English use as a job title is not securely dated, and the rank of college instructor varies by country.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代）：作为职称的最早英语用法年代不确，且大学讲师职级在不同国家并不一致。

note.en: Group one holds agent nouns that look or sound close to instructor; group two holds the teaching titles it is measured against.
note.cn: 第一组是形或音与 instructor 接近的施事名词；第二组是拿来与它比较的教学职称。

entries.definition: From a Latin verb meaning 'to prick or urge on', so an instigator starts trouble rather than teaching anyone.
entries.definitionCN: 来自表示「刺、怂恿」的拉丁动词，因此它指挑起事端的人，而非教导者。

entries.definition: Built on the same equipping verb but with a noun suffix, so it names the tool that equips the work.
entries.definitionCN: 同出那个表示「配备」的动词，但带名词后缀，指为工作配备的工具。

entries.definition: The rare passive counterpart, the person being taught; instructor is the one doing the teaching.
entries.definitionCN: 罕用的被动对应词，指被教的人；instructor 是施教的一方。

entries.definition: One who builds; it shares the building root but has nothing to do with lessons.
entries.definitionCN: 建造者；共享「建造」词根，但与教学无关。

entries.definition: The general word for someone who teaches in a school; instructor is narrower and often practical or college-level.
entries.definitionCN: 泛指在学校教书的人；instructor 范围更窄，常指实务训练或大学层次。

entries.definition: Someone who drills a practical skill, especially in sport or industry; it stresses repetition more than explanation.
entries.definitionCN: 训练实务技能的人，尤用于体育或行业；它更强调重复而非讲解。

entries.definition: A college teaching post that usually involves formal lectures; instructor may involve smaller classes.
entries.definitionCN: 大学教职，通常以正式讲座授课；instructor 可能带小班课。

entries.definition: Someone who improves another person's performance, often one to one; the word is warmer than instructor.
entries.definitionCN: 提升他人表现的人，常为一对一；语气比 instructor 更亲和。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the agent suffix, the skill settings where the word is used, and the family it belongs to.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：施事后缀、这个词被使用的技能场景，以及它所属的词族。

normal.en: The ending means 'the one who does it', so instructor is simply the person who instructs.
normal.cn: 这个词尾意为「做此事的人」，所以 instructor 就是执行教导的人。

normal.en: The title travels with any skill that needs correction at close range: driving, flying, skiing, lifting.
normal.cn: 凡是需要近身纠正的技能，都带着这个称谓：驾驶、飞行、滑雪、举重。

normal.en: A college instructor usually teaches smaller sections than a professor and may not hold a permanent post.
normal.cn: 大学讲师通常比教授带更小的班，且可能没有终身职位。

normal.en: Its verb is instruct and its abstract noun is instruction; three forms, one act.
normal.cn: 它的动词表示「教导」，抽象名词表示「教学」；三个形式，同一个动作。

normal.en: If the word appears on a car or an aircraft, expect a second set of controls.
normal.cn: 若这个词出现在汽车或飞机上，就该想到还有第二套操纵装置。

abstract.en: Picture two pairs of hands on one steering wheel.
abstract.cn: 想象两双手同时放在一个方向盘上。

abstract.en: Picture a voice counting while another body learns the rhythm.
abstract.cn: 想象一个声音在数拍子，另一个身体在学节奏。

abstract.en: Picture a ladder held steady at the bottom while someone climbs.
abstract.cn: 想象有人往上爬时，梯子在底下被人扶稳。

examples.en: The instructor cancelled the lesson because of the storm.
examples.cn: 教练因暴风雨取消了课程。

examples.en: New instructors shadow a senior colleague for a term.
examples.cn: 新讲师要跟一位资深同事听课一个学期。

examples.en: The flight instructor logged forty hours with her student.
examples.cn: 飞行教员与学员一起记录了四十小时飞行。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「引着搭的人」——把人引进门、搭起技能框架的人 → 教师、教练

root: 拉丁语「装备、安排、教导」这一动词的施事名词，词尾表示「做此事的人」；英语 instructor 指教师、讲师与教练。词根印欧来源属重构形式。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all name one person: the one who stands beside a learner and builds the skill in. The setting changes from college to car, gym, aircraft, slope, parade ground and even an old printed guide.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都指同一种人：站在学习者旁边、把技能搭进去的那个人。场景从大学换到汽车、健身房、飞机、雪坡、操练场，甚至一本古老的印刷指南。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a steady hand beside a learner, ready to correct or take over.
core.cn: 核心意象：学习者身旁一只稳定的手，随时准备纠正或接管。

branches.en: THE BUILDER: the college teacher and the Latin preparer both get another person ready.
branches.cn: 搭建者：大学讲师与拉丁语里的筹备者，都在让别人准备好。

branches.en: THE SECOND BRAKE: a driving lesson needs someone able to stop the car at once.
branches.cn: 第二副刹车：驾驶课需要有人能立刻把车停下。

branches.en: THE CORRECTING BODY: gym and slope both teach through repeated physical correction.
branches.cn: 纠正身体：健身房与雪坡都靠反复的身体纠正来教。

branches.en: HIGH-STAKES DRILL: aircraft and parade ground keep the title because the risk is real.
branches.cn: 高风险操练：飞机与操练场保留这个称谓，因为风险确实存在。

branches.en: THE PAPER TEACHER: an old guidebook could carry the name when no person was present.
branches.cn: 纸上的教师：在没有真人在场时，旧指南书也能承担这个名字。

intro.en: Instructor is built from a verb plus the Latin personal suffix, and the same pieces recur in a cluster of English words.
intro.cn: instructor 由一个动词加拉丁语表示人的后缀构成，同样的部件在若干英语词中反复出现。

latinIntro.en: The verb means 'to equip or teach'; the suffix marks the doer. Adding other suffixes to the same stem yields instruction and instructional.
latinIntro.cn: 动词意为「装备或教导」；后缀标记行动者。同一词干加其他后缀，就得到「教学」与「教学的」。

items.example: The verb supplies both the act and the agent.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词同时提供动作与行动者。

items.example: The suffix turns the act into a person.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把动作变成一个人。

items.structure: instruct (English verb, back-formed from the noun)
items.example: She instructs a class of thirty.
The instructions were printed on one sheet.
The older form is now rarely used.

latinEntries.meaning: to equip; to arrange; to teach

definition_zh: 教学，教书；教师职业；（复数）学说，教义；教导
definition_en: the work or activity of teaching, or the doctrines and lessons that a person or tradition passes on
core_image: 一个人指着黑板上的一个符号，另一个人顺着手指看过去，忽然明白了
scene: 山区教学点只有两间教室，一位老师同时带三个年级。Teaching in the mountain school meant preparing lessons for three year groups at once.
sceneCN: 这里 teaching 指「在学校里从事教学这项工作」（第 1 个义项：教学行为）；句意为在山区的这所学校教书，意味着要同时为三个年级备课。可辨识物件：两块黑板、复式课桌、粉笔盒、煤炉。

pos.zh: 教学，教书；教师职业；（复数）学说，教义

senses.title: The act of teaching
senses.definition: the activity of helping someone learn a subject or skill
senses.definitionCN: 帮助某人学习一门科目或技能的活动
senses.example: Teaching in the mountain school meant preparing three sets of lessons.
senses.exampleCN: 在山区学校教书意味着要备三套课。
senses.why: The noun simply names the activity that the verb describes, with no claim about method.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词只是命名动词所描述的活动，并不涉及方法。

senses.title: The profession
senses.definition: the occupation of working as a teacher, with its pay, hours and conditions
senses.definitionCN: 以教师为业的工作，连同其薪酬、工时与条件
senses.example: She entered teaching after ten years in industry.
senses.exampleCN: 她在行业里做了十年后进入教师行业。
senses.why: An activity becomes a profession when society pays people to do it regularly.
senses.whyCN: 一项活动在社会定期付钱请人做时，就成了职业。

senses.title: Doctrines and teachings
senses.definition: the body of ideas a religious or philosophical tradition passes down
senses.definitionCN: 宗教或哲学传统传下的一整套观念
senses.example: The teachings of the sect spread along the trade routes.
senses.exampleCN: 这个教派的教义沿贸易路线传播。
senses.why: What a teacher passes on outlives the lesson, so the plural names the lasting content.
senses.whyCN: 教师传下的东西比一堂课活得久，复数因此指持久的内容。

senses.title: Classroom practice
senses.definition: the observable methods used in lessons, such as questioning, grouping and modelling
senses.definitionCN: 课堂上可见的方法，如提问、分组与示范
senses.example: Her teaching relies on short tasks and immediate feedback.
senses.exampleCN: 她的教法依靠短任务与即时反馈。
senses.why: The word also names how teaching is done, not only that it is done.
senses.whyCN: 这个词还指教学是怎么做的，而不只是做了这件事。

senses.title: Religious instruction
senses.definition: the transmission of a faith's beliefs and practices to believers or children
senses.definitionCN: 向信徒或儿童传递某一信仰的观念与做法
senses.example: The parish runs teaching for children on Sunday mornings.
senses.exampleCN: 堂区在周日早晨为儿童开设教导课。
senses.why: Religions have used the word for transmitting doctrine far longer than schools have used it for lessons.
senses.whyCN: 宗教用这个词传递教义，比学校用它指课时要早得多。

senses.title: University teaching
senses.definition: the part of an academic job concerned with lectures, seminars and supervision
senses.definitionCN: 学术工作中涉及讲课、研讨与指导的部分
senses.example: Promotion now depends on teaching as well as research.
senses.exampleCN: 晋升如今既看研究也看教学。
senses.why: Modern universities split the job in two, and the word marks the half that faces students.
senses.whyCN: 现代大学把工作分成两半，这个词标记面向学生的那一半。

senses.title: A lesson drawn from a story
senses.definition: a moral or practical lesson that an event is said to contain
senses.definitionCN: 据说某件事所包含的道德或实际教训
senses.example: The collapse of the bridge carries a teaching about inspection.
senses.exampleCN: 桥梁倒塌这件事带来一条关于检查的教训。
senses.why: An event can teach without a teacher, so the word extends to lessons nobody intended to give.
senses.whyCN: 事件可以没有教师而教人，这个词因此扩展到无人有意给出的教训。

senses.title: Teaching a particular subject
senses.definition: instruction in one named subject, as in science teaching or language teaching
senses.definitionCN: 某一特定科目的教学，如科学教学或语言教学
senses.example: Science teaching improved once laboratories were refurbished.
senses.exampleCN: 实验室翻新后，科学教学有所改善。
senses.why: Naming the subject turns the general activity into a specific professional field.
senses.whyCN: 点明科目，就把一般活动变成具体的专业领域。

intro.en: Teaching is the noun from the Old English verb tæcan 'to show, point out, declare'. Its deeper root is reconstructed, and the dates are approximate.
intro.cn: teaching 来自古英语动词，意为「指出、显示、宣告」。其更深词根属重构形式，年代均为约数。

items.en: Tæcan meant 'to show, point out, declare and instruct'; the original image is pointing at something so that another sees it.
items.cn: 这个古英语动词意为「显示、指出、宣告、教导」；原初意象是指着某物，让另一个人看见。

items.en: The verb belongs to a Germanic family whose reconstructed form carries the sense of showing or signalling.
items.cn: 这个动词属于一个日耳曼词族，其重构形式带有「显示、示意」的意思。

items.en: English token, originally 'a sign', descends from the same deeper root, so a teacher is literally one who shows a sign.
items.cn: 英语中原本意为「记号」的那个词同出这一更深词根，所以教师字面上就是给出记号的人。

items.en: The verbal noun teaching appears in Middle English and slowly separates from the verb to name the activity itself.
items.cn: 动词性名词 teaching 出现于中古英语，并逐渐从动词分离出来，用来命名这项活动本身。

items.en: With mass schooling the noun also came to mean the paid occupation, and the plural came to mean a body of doctrine.
items.cn: 随大众教育兴起，这个名词也开始指有薪职业，其复数则指一套教义。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin): the Indo-European root behind the Germanic verb is reconstructed, and the exact first date of the professional sense is not recorded.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源）：日耳曼动词背后的印欧词根属重构形式，职业义的确切首见年代没有记录。

note.en: Group one holds words sharing the old showing root or the teaching family; group two holds the near synonyms that differ in scope.
note.cn: 第一组共享古老的「显示」词根或属于教学词族；第二组是范围有别的近义词。

entries.definition: A sign or object standing for something else; it descends from the same root as teach, where the core idea is pointing out.
entries.definitionCN: 代表他物的记号或物件；与「教」同出这一词根，核心意念都是「指出」。

entries.definition: The agent noun, the one who teaches; teaching is the activity or the doctrine, not the person.
entries.definitionCN: 施事名词，指教书的人；teaching 指活动或教义，不是人。

entries.definition: The verb names the act in progress; the noun can also name the profession or the content passed on.
entries.definitionCN: 动词命名进行中的动作；名词还可指职业或传下的内容。

entries.definition: From a Latin verb meaning 'to guard', so it stresses protection and supervision rather than showing.
entries.definitionCN: 来自表示「看守」的拉丁动词，强调保护与监督，而非「显示」。

entries.definition: Teaching viewed as organized method and clear direction; it sounds more technical than teaching.
entries.definitionCN: 被视为有组织的方法与明确指引的教学；比 teaching 更技术化。

entries.definition: The whole process and system of schooling, including administration and policy; teaching is only its core activity.
entries.definitionCN: 包括管理与政策在内的整个学校教育过程与制度；teaching 只是其核心活动。

entries.definition: The theory and study of teaching methods, not the daily activity itself.
entries.definitionCN: 关于教学方法的理论与研究，而非日常活动本身。

entries.definition: Teaching sold as lessons, often one to one or in small groups, and often outside school.
entries.definitionCN: 作为课程出售的教学，常为一对一或小班，且常在校外。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the original image of pointing, the real school phrases, and the plural that means doctrine.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：原初「指出」的意象、真实的学校说法，以及表示教义的复数。

normal.en: The oldest sense is pointing: a teacher shows something and another person sees it.
normal.cn: 最古老的意思是「指」：教师指出某物，另一个人看见了。

normal.en: The plural changes the meaning: teachings are doctrines, not lessons.
normal.cn: 复数会改变词义：复数形式指教义，而非课时。

normal.en: Institutional phrases mark the professional sense: teaching staff, teaching hospital, teaching practice.
normal.cn: 机构性说法标出职业义：教职员工、教学医院、教学实习。

normal.en: English token comes from the same deep root, which is why teaching and showing are historically one act.
normal.cn: 表示「记号」的那个词同出这一深层词根，这就是为什么「教」与「显示」在历史上是同一个动作。

normal.en: A teaching can outlive the teacher: the lesson remains after the lesson-giver is gone.
normal.cn: 教义可以比教师活得久：给出教训的人不在了，教训还在。

abstract.en: Picture a finger tracing a line on a map while another pair of eyes follows.
abstract.cn: 想象一根手指在地图上划过一条线，另一双眼睛跟着看。

abstract.en: Picture a lamp switched on in a room that was already furnished.
abstract.cn: 想象在一间本已布置好的屋子里打开一盏灯。

abstract.en: Picture a seed carried in a pocket long after the tree that made it is gone.
abstract.cn: 想象种子被装在口袋里，而生出它的那棵树早已不在。

examples.en: Teaching was her third career and the one she stayed in.
examples.cn: 教书是她的第三份职业，也是她留下来的那一份。

examples.en: The teachings of the school spread through student networks.
examples.cn: 这所学校的学说通过学生网络传播。

examples.en: Good teaching starts by finding out what students already believe.
examples.cn: 好的教学先从弄清学生已经相信什么开始。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「提示」——把答案指给学生看，就是教 → 教学、教义

root: 古英语动词「显示、指出、宣告」，深层词根与英语中表示「记号」的词同源；英语 teaching 指教学行为、教师职业，复数指学说。其印欧词根属重构形式。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses grow from one gesture: pointing something out so that another person sees it. The gesture becomes an activity, then a paid profession, then a method, then a doctrine that outlives the pointing hand.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从一个动作生长出来：指出某物，让另一个人看见。这个动作先成为活动，再成为有薪职业，然后成为方法，最后成为比那只指路的手活得更久的学说。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a finger pointing at a sign while another pair of eyes learns to read it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一根手指指出记号，另一双眼睛学会读懂它。

branches.en: THE ACT ITSELF: teaching begins as the plain activity of showing someone how something works.
branches.cn: 行为本身：教学起初只是向某人展示某物如何运作的平常活动。

branches.en: THE PAID ROLE: society turns the activity into a job with hours, pay and conditions.
branches.cn: 有薪角色：社会把这项活动变成有工时、薪酬与条件的职业。

branches.en: METHOD AND FIELD: practice, university teaching and subject teaching each name a way the act is organised.
branches.cn: 方法与领域：课堂实践、大学教学与学科教学，各自命名这一动作的组织方式。

branches.en: WHAT IS HANDED ON: doctrine and religious instruction are content that survives the lesson.
branches.cn: 传下的内容：教义与宗教教导是比课时活得更久的内容。

branches.en: THE LESSON WITHOUT A TEACHER: an event can teach a lesson nobody planned to give.
branches.cn: 没有教师的教训：事件也能给出无人计划要给的教训。

intro.en: Teaching is a native English noun made from a verb plus the -ing ending; its family is short but very productive.
intro.cn: teaching 是英语本族名词，由动词加表示动作的英语词尾构成；其词族虽短，却很有能产性。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin source here: the verb is Old English, and the endings are native. The deeper root is shared with token.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁语来源：动词是古英语，词尾也是本族的。更深词根与表示「记号」的词共享。

items.meaning: the act or result of doing
items.example: The ending turns the verb into an activity.
items.exampleCN: 这个词尾把动词变成一项活动。

items.meaning: the activity or profession of teaching

items.example: The teachings were written down by students.
items.exampleCN: 这些学说由学生记录下来。

items.example: The teacher kept the class quiet.

items.meaning: a hospital where students are trained
items.example: The teaching hospital trains third-year students.
items.exampleCN: 这所教学医院训练三年级学生。

items.meaning: an object or tool used in lessons
items.example: Maps are the oldest teaching aid.

definition_zh: 教师，老师；导师；（宗教）教师；给人教训的事物
definition_en: a person whose job is to teach, especially in a school, or anyone who passes knowledge and skill to others
core_image: 一个人站在黑板前，把粉笔掰成两半，一半留着下节课用
scene: 乡村小学的教室里，一位老师把粉笔掰成两半，省着用。The teacher split the chalk in two so that it would last the week.
sceneCN: 这里 teacher 指「在学校里以教书为职业的人」（第 1 个义项：学校教师）；句意为这位老师把一支粉笔掰成两截，好让粉笔能用到周末。可辨识物件：黑板、粉笔、木质课桌、窗外的山坡。

pos.zh: 教师，老师；导师；（宗教）教师；给人教训的事物

senses.title: A school teacher
senses.definition: a person employed by a school to teach classes of pupils
senses.definitionCN: 受雇于学校、给班级学生上课的人
senses.example: The teacher split the chalk in two so that it would last the week.
senses.exampleCN: 这位老师把粉笔掰成两半，好让它用到周末。
senses.why: The agent suffix simply marks the person who performs the act of teaching, and the school setting supplies the rest.
senses.whyCN: 施事后缀只标记执行教学动作的人，其余含义由学校场景提供。

senses.title: A private teacher
senses.definition: someone paid directly to teach one pupil or a small group, often at home
senses.definitionCN: 由个人直接付酬、教一名学生或一个小班的人，常上门授课
senses.example: They hired a teacher for mathematics twice a week.
senses.exampleCN: 他们每周请两次数学家教。
senses.why: The word does not require a school; anyone who teaches for payment can carry it.
senses.whyCN: 这个词并不要求学校，任何受酬教课的人都能用它。

senses.title: A teacher of a skill
senses.definition: an instructor of a practical art such as music, driving or swimming
senses.definitionCN: 教授音乐、驾驶、游泳等实用技艺的人
senses.example: Her piano teacher made her count aloud.
senses.exampleCN: 她的钢琴老师让她大声数拍。
senses.why: Skills are taught rather than lectured, yet the plain word still covers the role.
senses.whyCN: 技能靠教而非靠讲，平实的这个词仍然覆盖这一角色。

senses.title: A religious teacher
senses.definition: a figure who transmits doctrine and moral guidance, as a rabbi or a guru
senses.definitionCN: 传递教义与道德指引的人物，如拉比或上师
senses.example: The villagers called him a teacher before they called him a priest.
senses.exampleCN: 村民先称他为教师，后来才称他为祭司。
senses.why: The oldest use of the word in many traditions is religious, because doctrine is what was taught.
senses.whyCN: 在许多传统中这个词最古老的用法是宗教性的，因为所教的是教义。

senses.title: A moral guide
senses.definition: a person whose example shapes how others behave
senses.definitionCN: 以自身榜样影响他人行为的人
senses.example: She was the teacher who taught them how to disagree politely.
senses.exampleCN: 她是教会他们如何礼貌地表达分歧的那位老师。
senses.why: Teaching is not only information transfer; conduct is also shown and copied.
senses.whyCN: 教学不只是传递信息，行为也会被示范并被模仿。

senses.title: A college teacher
senses.definition: a member of academic staff who teaches students at college or university
senses.definitionCN: 在学院或大学给学生授课的学术人员
senses.example: Her teacher at college later became her co-author.
senses.exampleCN: 她在大学的老师后来成了她的合著者。
senses.why: The word scales up without changing form, though professor or lecturer is more precise.
senses.whyCN: 这个词无需变形就能扩展到高等教育，不过教授或讲师更精确。

senses.title: Something that teaches
senses.definition: an event or experience that makes someone wiser, spoken of as if it were a person
senses.definitionCN: 使人变得更有智慧的事件或经历，被当成人来说
senses.example: Failure is a harsh teacher.
senses.exampleCN: 失败是一位严厉的老师。
senses.why: Anything that changes what a person knows can be personified as a teacher.
senses.whyCN: 任何改变一个人所知的事物，都可以被拟人化为教师。

senses.title: A student teacher
senses.definition: a trainee who teaches under supervision while qualifying
senses.definitionCN: 在取得资格期间于督导下授课的实习者
senses.example: The student teacher took the class for one afternoon.
senses.exampleCN: 实习教师带了一个下午的课。
senses.why: The compound marks the stage before the title is fully earned.
senses.whyCN: 这个复合词标记的是正式取得头衔之前的阶段。

intro.en: Teacher is the native English agent noun of teach, recorded in Old English as tæcere. Its deeper root is shared with token, and the dates are approximate.
intro.cn: teacher 是表示「教」的动词的英语本族施事名词，古英语已有相应形式。其更深词根与 token 共享，年代均为约数。

items.en: The verb meant 'to show, point out, declare, instruct'; teaching began as pointing something out to someone.
items.cn: 这个动词意为「显示、指出、宣告、教导」；教学起初就是向某人指出某物。

items.en: The agent noun tæcere 'teacher' was formed with the native -ere ending, the ancestor of modern -er.
items.cn: 施事名词「教师」由本族的施事词尾构成，这一词尾就是现代施事后缀的前身。

items.en: The form settled into teacher, and the word covered both religious and secular instructors.
items.cn: 形式固定为 teacher，这个词同时覆盖宗教与世俗的教导者。

items.en: With compulsory schooling the word became a job title with training, pay scales and a professional body.
items.cn: 随义务教育推行，这个词成了带有培训、薪酬等级与行业协会的职称。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin): the reconstructed Indo-European root behind the Germanic verb is not directly attested, and the first use as a formal job title is not dated.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源）：日耳曼动词背后的印欧词根属重构形式，无直接书证；作为正式职称的首见年代亦无记录。

note.en: Group one holds titles from other roots that are constantly interchanged with teacher; group two holds the wider roles a teacher is compared with.
note.cn: 第一组是来自其他词根、却常与 teacher 互混的头衔；第二组是拿来与教师比较的更大角色。

entries.definition: From a Latin verb meaning 'to guard or watch', so a tutor supervises a pupil's study rather than simply teaching a class.
entries.definitionCN: 来自表示「看守、照看」的拉丁动词，因此家教或导师是监督学生学习，而不只是给一个班上课。

entries.definition: Built on a Latin verb for equipping and arranging; it is the usual title for skill training and college teaching.
entries.definitionCN: 由表示「装备、安排」的拉丁动词构成；它是技能训练与大学教学的常用头衔。

entries.definition: From a Latin verb meaning 'to declare publicly'; it is a rank in a university, not a synonym for every teacher.
entries.definitionCN: 来自表示「公开宣告」的拉丁动词；它是大学里的职级，并非所有教师的同义词。

entries.definition: One who drills a practical skill through repetition; a teacher may explain and examine, which a trainer seldom does.
entries.definitionCN: 靠重复训练实务技能的人；教师会讲解与考核，而训练员很少这样做。

entries.definition: Someone who works in education, often with a claim about forming character, not only delivering lessons.
entries.definitionCN: 从事教育工作的人，常带有塑造人格的主张，而不只是上课。

entries.definition: A teacher who works with one pupil or a very small group, usually to support school work.
entries.definitionCN: 只教一名学生或极小班组的教师，通常用于辅导学校课业。

entries.definition: An experienced person who advises another over years; the relation is personal rather than timetabled.
entries.definitionCN: 多年间给他人建议的有经验者；这种关系是私人的，而非排进课表的。

entries.definition: A college teacher whose main format is the lecture; the title says how the teaching is delivered.
entries.definitionCN: 以讲座为主要形式的高校教师；这一头衔说明教学如何交付。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the pointing root, the school phrases, and the family that grows from the same verb.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：「指出」词根、学校里的固定说法，以及由同一动词生长出的词族。

normal.en: The oldest meaning is 'one who shows', which is why the word needs no Latin to explain it.
normal.cn: 最古老的意思是「指出的人」，所以这个词不需要拉丁语也能解释。

normal.en: The same verb gives teach, teaching, teacher and teachable, one family with four useful forms.
normal.cn: 同一个动词给出四个有用形式：教、教学、教师、可教的。

normal.en: School phrases fix the professional sense: head teacher, class teacher, teacher training.
normal.cn: 学校里的固定说法固定了职业义：校长、班主任、师资培训。

normal.en: A teacher can be a person, a book, or an experience, as long as something is learned.
normal.cn: 教师可以是人、一本书或一段经历，只要有人学到了东西。

normal.en: Token and teacher share a deep root, both built on the idea of a sign being shown.
normal.cn: 表示「记号」的词与 teacher 共享深层词根，两者都建立在「展示记号」这一意念上。

abstract.en: Picture a lamp held up in a dark corridor, not the corridor itself.
abstract.cn: 想象有人在黑暗走廊里举着一盏灯，灯不是走廊本身。

abstract.en: Picture a key handed over and then used by someone else.
abstract.cn: 想象一把钥匙被交出去，随后由别人使用。

abstract.en: Picture a footprint left on soft ground for a later walker to follow.
abstract.cn: 想象松软地面上留下的脚印，供后来者跟随。

examples.en: Every teacher in the building knew the boy by name.
examples.cn: 楼里每位老师都能叫出那个男孩的名字。

examples.en: Her first teacher was a neighbour with a piano.
examples.cn: 她的第一位老师是一位家里有钢琴的邻居。

examples.en: Experience is an expensive teacher but a memorable one.
examples.cn: 经验是昂贵的老师，却令人难忘。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「指出的人」——把答案指给你看的那个人 → 老师

root: 古英语动词「显示、指出、教导」加本族施事后缀，构成「指出的人」，即教师；深层词根与英语 token（记号）同源，其印欧祖形属重构形式。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all name one role: the person who shows something until another can see it. The role moves from a school post to a paid tutor, a skill coach, a religious guide, a moral example and even a hard experience.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都指同一个角色：把某物指给别人看、直到对方看见的人。这个角色从学校岗位移到付费家教、技能教练、宗教导师、道德榜样，甚至一段严酷的经历。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person holding up a sign until another pair of eyes can read it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个人举着记号，直到另一双眼睛能读懂。

branches.en: THE POST: school and college teaching are the same role at two levels of the system.
branches.cn: 岗位：中小学与高校教师，是同一角色在制度中的两个层级。

branches.en: THE PAID HOUR: private lessons and the trainee stage both mark teaching as work with a price.
branches.cn: 按小时付酬：家教与实习阶段都标记教学是一份有价钱的工作。

branches.en: SKILL AND DOCTRINE: piano and scripture are both transmitted by a person, not by a textbook alone.
branches.cn: 技艺与教义：钢琴与经文都靠人传递，单靠教科书不够。

branches.en: THE EXAMPLE: conduct is copied, so a teacher can teach without speaking.
branches.cn: 榜样：行为会被模仿，因此教师不说话也能教。

branches.en: THE FIGURE OF SPEECH: failure and experience are called teachers because they change what we know.
branches.cn: 修辞里的教师：失败与经验被称作老师，因为它们改变了我们所知。

intro.en: Teacher is a native formation: a verb plus the agent ending. The family is small but every member is common.
intro.cn: teacher 是本族构词：动词加施事词尾。词族不大，但每个成员都很常用。

latinIntro.en: No Latin element is involved; the ending descends from Old English. The deep root is shared with the word for a sign.
latinIntro.cn: 这里不涉及拉丁成分；词尾来自古英语。其深层词根与表示「记号」的词共享。

items.example: The ending marks the person, not the act.
items.exampleCN: 这个词尾标记人，而不是动作。

items.meaning: able to be taught; willing to learn
in the manner of a teacher
items.exampleCN: 她像老师那样点了点头。

definition_zh: 学习过程；获取知识与技能的整个过程；教学材料中预设的学习步骤
definition_en: the sequence of steps by which a person acquires knowledge or skill, from first exposure to confident use
core_image: 一个学生先在纸上写下猜测，再动手试，失败后用橡皮擦掉重写，本子上留下三轮痕迹
scene: 实验室里，学生先猜、再试、再改，记录本上留下三轮不同的做法。The learning process was recorded step by step, including the wrong guesses.
sceneCN: 这里 learning process 指「学习者从初次接触到达成掌握所经历的一连串步骤」（第 1 个义项：获取知识技能的整体过程）；句意为这个学习过程被一步步记录下来，连错误的猜测也写了进去。可辨识物件：实验记录本、铅笔、橡皮、烧杯。

pos.zh: 学习过程；获取知识与技能的步骤序列

senses.title: Acquiring knowledge over time
senses.definition: the whole sequence by which a person moves from ignorance to understanding
senses.definitionCN: 一个人从不知到理解所经历的整体序列
senses.example: The learning process was recorded step by step, including the wrong guesses.
senses.exampleCN: 这个学习过程被逐步记录，连错误的猜测也写下了。
senses.why: Process means an advance through stages, and learning is exactly such an advance.
senses.whyCN: 「过程」意为经过若干阶段的推进，而学习正是这样一种推进。

senses.title: Stages from novice to mastery
senses.titleCN: 从生手到熟练的各阶段
senses.definition: the ordered stages a learner passes through in a skill, such as imitation, practice and fluency
senses.definitionCN: 学习者在某项技能中经过的有序阶段，如模仿、练习与流畅
senses.example: The learning process for the violin begins with posture, not with tunes.
senses.exampleCN: 小提琴的学习过程从姿势开始，而不是从曲子开始。
senses.why: A skill is not acquired in one step, so the word names the ladder rather than the arrival.
senses.whyCN: 技能不是一步到位的，所以这个词命名的是梯子，而非抵达。

senses.title: The cognitive process
senses.definition: the mental operations of attention, memory and reasoning by which new material is taken in
senses.definitionCN: 注意、记忆与推理等把新素材纳入心智的活动
senses.example: Researchers mapped the learning process in children solving puzzles.
senses.exampleCN: 研究者描绘了儿童解谜时的学习过程。
senses.why: Psychology looks inside the learner, and what it finds is a process rather than a moment.
senses.whyCN: 心理学往学习者内部看，看到的是一段过程，而非一个瞬间。

senses.title: Learning in school
senses.definition: the classroom sequence of explanation, exercise, feedback and revision
senses.definitionCN: 课堂上讲解、练习、反馈与复习的序列
senses.example: Teachers design the learning process around one clear question.
senses.exampleCN: 教师围绕一个清楚的问题设计学习过程。
senses.why: Schooling makes the process visible and repeatable by writing it into lessons.
senses.whyCN: 学校教育把这一过程写进课时，使它可见且可重复。

senses.title: Adult learning
senses.definition: the different sequence adults follow when they bring experience and clear goals to study
senses.definitionCN: 成人带着经验与明确目标学习时所走的另一条路径
senses.example: Adult learning processes rely more on problems than on drills.
senses.exampleCN: 成人的学习过程更依赖问题，而非反复操练。
senses.why: Experience changes the order of steps, which is why adult learning is studied separately.
senses.whyCN: 经验改变了步骤顺序，所以成人学习被单独研究。

senses.title: Organisational learning
senses.definition: the way a team or company turns experience into changed routines and shared knowledge
senses.definitionCN: 团队或公司把经验转化为改变的惯例与共享知识的方式
senses.example: The firm treats every failed launch as part of its learning process.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司把每次失败的发布都当作自身学习过程的一部分。
senses.why: Groups can learn as well as individuals, and the same word is extended to them.
senses.whyCN: 群体和个人一样能学习，这个词因此被扩展到群体。

senses.title: Judging the process
senses.definition: the assessment of how a learner works, not only of the final result
senses.definitionCN: 对学习者如何学习的评价，而不只看最终结果
senses.example: The portfolio assesses the learning process rather than the final essay.
senses.exampleCN: 这份档案评估的是学习过程，而非期末论文。
senses.why: If learning is a route, then progress can be judged along the route, not only at the end.
senses.whyCN: 若学习是一条路线，那么进度可以沿途评判，而不只在终点。

senses.title: A planned sequence in materials
senses.titleCN: 教学材料中的预设步骤
senses.definition: the order of steps built into a textbook, course or program so that learners proceed gradually
senses.definitionCN: 教科书、课程或程序里预设的步骤顺序，使学习者逐步推进
senses.example: The software slows the learning process down for beginners.
senses.exampleCN: 这款软件为初学者放慢学习过程的节奏。
senses.why: Designers lay out the route in advance, and the compound becomes a technical term.
senses.whyCN: 设计者预先铺好路线，这个复合词于是成了技术术语。

intro.en: Learning process joins a native English verb for learning to a Latin noun for advance. Both parts carry a journey image, and the dates are approximate.
intro.cn: learning process 把一个表示「学习」的英语本族动词与一个表示「推进」的拉丁名词组合起来。两部分都带旅程意象，年代均为约数。

items.en: Leornian meant 'to get knowledge, be cultivated'; the older image is following a track rather than receiving facts.
items.cn: 这个古英语动词意为「获得知识、受到培养」；较早的意象是沿着一条轨迹走，而非接收事实。

items.en: The verb belongs to a Germanic family built on a reconstructed root meaning 'track' or 'furrow'.
items.cn: 这个动词属于一个日耳曼词族，建立在表示「轨迹」或「犁沟」的重构词根上。

items.en: Processus meant 'a going forward, an advance', from procedere 'to go forward', built on 'forward' plus 'to go'.
items.cn: 这个拉丁名词意为「前进、推进」，来自表示「向前走」的动词，由「向前」加「走」构成。

items.en: English took process in the fourteenth century for a course of events, and later for a method of manufacture.
items.cn: 英语在十四世纪借入表示「过程」的这个名词，指事件的过程，后来又指制造方法。

items.en: The compound learning process spread with psychology and education in the nineteenth and twentieth centuries.
items.cn: 这个复合词随心理学与教育学在十九、二十世纪扩散开来。
